integrity_notes: The analytic proof establishes all infinite limits; finite computations are reproducibility cross-checks only. The contribution is not presented as independent certification.
limitations: Pointwise Marchaud derivative for a polynomially growing past tail; the datum is not L1, and conclusions do not cover other samplers, truncation, or arbitrary fixed coarse meshes.
title: A sharp mesh–sampling phase law for Sibuya Grünwald differentiation of polynomial past tails
